description: Non-custodial Web3 settlement layer turning stablecoins into real-world utility payments (electricity, airtime, data, cable TV, education, bank transfers) for emerging markets on Celo & Base. An autonomous AI agent (ERC-8004 identity, 8004scan.io) pays bills unattended via Telegram/WhatsApp/X — bounded allowances, autopay, batch payments.

tool_signatures.name: payBillViaX402
tool_signatures.description: Settles a real-world bill payment via the x402 protocol. The caller pays in a supported stablecoin on Celo or Base; on confirmed settlement, AbaPay vends the underlying service (airtime top-up, data bundle, electricity token, cable subscription) through its provider integration and returns the result. Price is dynamic — it equals the live value of the bill being paid, converted to the settlement token at the platform's current exchange rate, plus any applicable service fee and a flat $0.001 facilitator fee, so there is no fixed catalog price for this resource. For ELECTRICITY, BANK, JAMB (EDUCATION), and CABLE (except Showmax), the meter/account/smartcard number is checked against the biller only AFTER settlement, not before — a wrong-but-plausible number still settles on-chain, then fails verification and is refunded automatically rather than being rejected upfront.

token.description: On Celo, both USDC and USDT (Tether) settle via x402 — each implements EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization. On Base, USDC only (Base USDT has no transferWithAuthorization). cUSD/USDm are never supported (no transferWithAuthorization).

blockchain.description: Celo settles through Celo's own x402 facilitator; Base settles through Coinbase's CDP facilitator
